nodes.label: ATS Compliance Design Principle for Resume Output
nodes.norm_label: ats compliance design principle for resume output
nodes.rationale: Resumes must parse correctly through automated Applicant Tracking Systems. This drives the 1-column layout option, ATS-friendly template design, and the mandatory review step that scores ATS compliance for every generated output.

nodes.label: Profile Immutability Rule — DO NOT MODIFY profile.md
nodes.norm_label: profile immutability rule — do not modify profile.md
nodes.rationale: Profile.md is the single factual source of truth; allowing modifications would risk introducing inaccurate or invented content into generated resumes. All generators and tailoring agents read it but must never write to it.
